title: Dubai Off-Plan Forecast for 2027: A Correction, Not a Collapse

body:
Everyone wants to know the same thing about Dubai right now: is it a correction or a crash? Here is my answer, with a clear label on it. This is my opinion, not financial advice. Nobody can predict the world.

## Where the market stands, in short

As of October 2026, Dubai sold about 38% fewer homes in the third quarter than a year earlier. The ValuStrat index puts prices about 10% below their February peak, with apartments falling harder than villas. A large wave of new supply is still scheduled for delivery.

## My view on the next six months

- Sales stay low.
- Prices move sideways or slide down, mostly apartments in the areas with the most new supply.
- More developers offer discounts and longer payment plans.
- Many buyers hold their money and wait on the sideline.

## Why 2027 is the real test

2027 is when the keys arrive. Many investors who bought off-plan to flip at handover will meet more competition than they expected. More units on the secondary market means more pressure on rents. I expect apartment prices to keep correcting through 2027, while villas and prime locations hold up much better.

## The wildcard: geopolitics

The biggest unknown is the region itself. If it finds real stability, this market can come back, and faster than most people expect. If the conflict gets worse, the correction gets deeper and longer.

## My call

This is a correction, not a collapse. 2027 is the year the market finds its floor. For patient buyers, the window opens between the end of 2027 and 2028.

For developers, the message is simple. The time of selling on hype is over, at least for now. Buyers are asking whether the project is real, whether it will be delivered, and what exactly they are buying. The developers who answer those questions clearly will keep selling.

For the full numbers, the expert views and the developer strategies behind this forecast, listen to the full episode at [/podcast/dubai-off-plan-correction-or-crash-my-forecast/](/podcast/dubai-off-plan-correction-or-crash-my-forecast/).
